claims.claim: People already entitled to the full new State Pension are excluded from paying voluntary Class 3 contributions.
claims.quote: You cannot pay voluntary contributions if you: do not have gaps in your National Insurance record
claims.note: The text excludes people with no gaps in their record, not people already entitled to the full State Pension; it only says voluntary contributions do not always increase the State Pension.

claims.claim: The full new State Pension requires 35 qualifying years.
claims.quote: If your National Insurance record started after April 2016 you will need 35 qualifying years to get the full rate of new State Pension.
claims.note: The text states 35 qualifying years for the full rate (more if contracted out before 2016).
